items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And Warren Kime and these kind of guys. I mean, just jazz players...

ctx.x: Right, right, it was very -- and then he opened the phone calls, they had phone calls. And I talked to people -- I mean, man, I wouldn't dream of listening.

Rav Martury was one, he called. And Warren Kime and these kind of guys. I mean, just jazz players and besides the musicians, then the jazz public. And all the musicians. And I got so many compliments -- not compliments, but so many people said they heard me, that didn't even call. And in a short period of time, that phone was jumping. Yeah.
You're sort of the father figure in Chicago music.
